_comment: eSpeak-NG's raw output, captured on a real device. Empty until then --
see test/espeak_fixture_test.dart, which skips itself while it is.
To fill it: run the app on a phone, open the TTS debugger, press
'Copy fixture JSON', and paste the clipboard over this file. The button
phonemizes every word in `phrases` below through the unnormalized
backend, which is exactly what this fixture is.
Do not hand-write entries. The point of the file is that it is what the
native library actually said; invented IPA would test the fixture, not
phrases: the cat sat on a mat
The rain in Spain stays mainly in the plain
